scope: Targeted verification of the server interpreter wrapper around the unchanged browser flight_core.wasm212; not full combined-mode or deployment acceptance
sourceStatus: Runtime and tests were local uncommitted additions when verified; no commit or deployment performed by this audit

runtime.isolation: Engine and Module shared; every aircraft has an independent Store, Instance, memory and C static state
runtime.terrain: World imports use the shared MapGround sampler including authored overlays; landing eligibility requires explicit LandingArea regions
runtime.math: f32 WASM operands promoted to f64 host sin/cos/asin/acos/atan2/exp and narrowed to f32, matching the browser import boundary
runtime.debugDispatchFix: With default features disabled, omitting auto-dispatch caused a real unoptimized native stack overflow. Explicit auto-dispatch selects the portable interpreter loop for opt-level0/1 instead of relying on LLVM sibling-call optimization. No enlarged thread stack or core modification was used.
runtime.stateLimit: 80+48 telemetry floats are a serialized observation, not a complete restorable execution context; hidden C state remains in its instance

verification.command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 cargo test -p tg-server --lib flight_runtime::tests -- --nocapture

tests.name: pinned_module_checks_identity_abi_memory_and_rejects_invalid_admission
tests.evidence: Exact artifact and ABI, 128KiB memory, invalid landing region, oversized dt/nonfinite controls/invalid flags/damage rejected without changing telemetry, serde round trip

tests.name: two_different_airframes_interleaved_match_their_independent_execution
tests.evidence: Different piston and jet configurations interleaved in separate instances match their isolated runs, including instructor hidden-state effects

tests.name: actual_world_sampling_parked_controls_and_airborne_roll_are_connected
tests.evidence: Actual Korea terrain height/parked AGL; explicit test-only landing pad; parked A/D actuator response and opposite accepted airborne roll response; not a model hinge/mesh audit or airport certification

tests.name: accepted_damage_reduces_real_kernel_thrust_and_impulse_changes_plant
tests.evidence: Engine damage reduces actual kernel thrust and speed; accepted velocity/angular impulses alter plant state

tests.name: host_trap_returns_result_and_prevents_continuation_of_partial_state
tests.evidence: Test-only world callback trap becomes Result error and faults the instance; subsequent telemetry/step cannot continue partial state

tests.name: same_wasm_parameters_and_command_sequence_match_node_browser_math
tests.evidence: Same real WASM, production client terrain sampler and f32 parameter/control/damage/impulse sequence in Node compared with wasmi

performance.probe: 80 interpreter steps plus two instances/configuration during the unoptimized parallel test run
performance.limit: Not a standalone benchmark; no release build, maximum player/aircraft load, mobile, browser rendering or network performance claim. Root records release mixed-world evidence separately.

excluded: Air domain ownership/ammunition/shot admission and actual mixed-world tests are separate integration evidence
Full model geometry and animation fidelity
Full Korean/Taiwan maps, logistics, infantry and support vehicles
